\title{A Prospective Falsification-First Architecture for\\
Pure Genus-Two Homology-Cover Renormalization}
\author{Liang Wang\textsuperscript{1}\\
\date{2 September 2026}

P32 studies a fixed renormalization proposal for the pure genus-two
homology-cover tower
$H_N=\ker(\Gamma\to H_1(\Sigma;\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z))$.

Physical
lifted time is scaled by exactly $1/N$, and the logarithm of the
raw lift-component product by exactly $1/N^3$.

The universal
endpoint asks for recovery of every oriented primitive base-owner
factor.

Adversarial review found that the earlier four-package presentation
understated the adverse information already visible in its own
prospective local factors.

The present article therefore adopts a
falsification-first architecture.

Conditional on a future derivation of
those factors, positive content \texttt{d\textgreater{}1} and zero
content become the first theorem targets; they must be settled before
formal or compact-uniform resources are invested in the exceptional
content-one stratum.

The content-one analytic program is now explicitly
contingent and secondary.

The project-defined inverse-limit object
\texttt{R\_+}, its localizations and projections, and the separate
zero-content Hahn object remain unresolved constructions.

Likewise, any
analytic tail theorem is conditional on survival of the local tests and
would require an absolute logarithmic-summand majorant uniform on each
frozen compact set and compatible with every specified limit order.

The
executed work remains literature synthesis over 26 frozen sources and
review-informed argument design.

No factor, mismatch, obstruction,
recovery statement, panel, or limit has been proved or computed.

Across the current 30-row matrix, four prior closest-work scopes remain
bounded, 18 inherited-source exact locators are finalized, and eight
inherited uses are explicitly metadata-only because no passage-bearing
locator was finalized.

P32-S13 remains bibliographically
\texttt{VERIFIED} but belongs to that bounded-unavailability group; none
of these passage statuses establishes a project theorem.

Arithmetic A0 remains unavailable, the formal
Route-A tuple is unassigned, positive arithmetic A2 is absent, and Route
B remains closed.
本文研究純種屬二同調覆蓋塔的固定重整化方案。 基底是帶標記的封閉雙曲曲面及單位速度測地流， 所有者涵蓋全部同調內容的 保持方向本原共軛類， 逆類仍分開處理。 物理提升時間嚴格乘以 $1/N$， 原始提升分量乘積的對數 嚴格乘以 $1/N^3$； 不允許依內容或結果調整。
本文採取先否證後一致的架構： 只有在未來自足推導局部因子後， 才先檢驗正的高內容與零內容； 兩者均存活後， 才可投入例外的內容一子乘積、 形式拓撲與緊集上一致尾項分析。 因此內容一只是附條件的次要端點， 絕不能代替全所有者回復， 也不能移植至另一個殘餘逆極限系統。 正內容的逆極限物件、 局部化與投影， 以及零內容的獨立 Hahn 型物件 均尚未構造。

本階段僅執行封閉語料綜合 與審查後方法設計； 未執行所有者綁定、 覆蓋計算、 因子推導、 係數比較、 面板、 尾界或極限。 目前三十列矩陣中，十八項繼承來源已有精確且逐列限定的段落定位，四項最近工作脈絡僅保留既有定位而未在本輪鎖定材料中綁定摘錄與雜湊，故仍不可核；另八項因未完成可承載段落的定位而明確限於書目中介資料；P32-S13 的書目身分已核為 \texttt{VERIFIED}，但仍屬後一類，且任何定位狀態均不建立本計畫的定理； 本文不宣稱阻礙、 回復、新穎性或路線晉級。

Finite-cover products can agree on a selected stratum or finite panel
without recovering every primitive owner.

P32 fixes this distinction at
the object level.

The base is a marked closed hyperbolic genus-two
surface with unit-speed geodesic flow and presentation

The cover tower is the pure homology tower
\texttt{H\_N=ker(Gamma\ -\textgreater{}\ H\_1(Sigma;Z/NZ))}.

It is not
the residual inverse-limit object studied in the preceding branch, and a
conclusion about one tower cannot repair the other.

Owners are oriented
primitive surface-group conjugacy classes; inverse classes remain
separately oriented.

For an owner with homology vector in
\texttt{Z\^{}4}, content \texttt{d} is the greatest common divisor of
the absolute coordinates, with zero content treated as a separate case.
The normalization is immutable.

Physical lifted time is multiplied by
exactly \texttt{1/N}, and the logarithm of the raw lift-component
product is multiplied by exactly \texttt{1/N\^{}3}.

Content-dependent
changes, outcome-dependent weights, adaptive schedules, and
favorable-panel selection are prohibited.

The universal endpoint
concerns all owner contents, not an average and not the content-one
subproduct alone.

\textbf{Do the prospectively derived local factors for higher-content
and zero-content owners already obstruct the frozen \texttt{1/N} and
\texttt{1/N\^{}3} full-owner recovery scheme; and only if those adverse
tests are survived, what formal and analytic obligations remain for the
content-one subproduct?}
The change is methodological.

It does not assert that the candidate factors
are correct or that an obstruction exists.

Higher- and zero-content checks are
earlier in the declared dependency graph because they require fewer named
downstream objects than formal topology and compact-uniform tails.

This is not
an empirical runtime, proof-complexity, or information-gain estimate.

A closed

scheme; survival would license only the next predeclared obligation.

content-one statement, if eventually proved, would remain restricted.

This corrects a potentially misleading shorthand in an older
state description and prevents a favorable exceptional stratum from
being substituted for the frozen all-owner endpoint.
Three gates organize the program.

The owner gate must bind equality,
oriented conjugacy, maximal roots, inverse handling, serialization, and
prefix completeness to the marked presentation.

The local-factor gate
must derive cover order, component multiplicity, primitive-lift status,
rescaled period, and normalized exponent for each relevant content.

The
formal/analytic gate must supply the coefficient objects and, if local
tests survive, the uniform tail theorem.

A failure at an earlier gate
stops later work; it is not repaired by changing a schedule, selecting a
favorable panel, or moving to a different tower.

The falsification-first order is therefore informational rather than
promotional.

It asks the shortest exact questions capable of deciding
the universal proposal while leaving survival, obstruction, and
not-evaluable outcomes all open.

The architecture does not infer a
mismatch from the displayed shapes of unproved formulas, and it does not
infer convergence from a finite diagnostic plan.
